prompt: 四空五選的題目裡，空格前一句說：Many students feel nervous before exams. 空格後一句說：This is why schools offer relaxation workshops. 空格最需要什麼樣的句子？
options: Stress can affect sleep and concentration.
Relaxation workshops are held in the gym.
answer: Stress can affect sleep and concentration.

wrong.Relaxation workshops are held in the gym: 這句只講地點，後面的 This is why 需要一個說明原因的前句，這句無法承接。
籃球與緊張、放鬆課程無關，使上下文脫節。

why: This is why 前面要有「原因」，說明壓力影響睡眠與專注，才能導出學校開設放鬆課程。
tip: This is why 前面找原因句。
say: Stress can affect sleep and concentration.

prompt: in the following sentence 中的 This 指的是什麼？
text: Tom skipped breakfast and ran to school. This made him feel dizzy in class.
options: 他沒吃早餐就跑去學校這件事
answer: 他沒吃早餐就跑去學校這件事

wrong.早餐: This 指前面整件事，不只是 breakfast；而且頭暈是因為沒吃又跑步造成的。
wrong.學校: school 只是地點，不會讓人頭暈，This 指整個情況。

why: 句首 This 可指前一句整個事件，本題是不吃早餐又跑步。
tip: 句首 This 常指前面整件事。
say: This made him feel dizzy in class.

prompt: 選出最能連接前後句意的轉折語。
text: The app is cheap. _____, it is not very easy to use.

wrong.Therefore: Therefore 表示因果，但 cheap 與 not easy to use 是一好一壞的轉折。
wrong.For example: 後句不是舉例說明便宜，而是講缺點。

why: 前句是優點、後句是缺點，需要轉折語 However。
say: The app is cheap. However, it is not very easy to use.

prompt: 哪一句的指涉清楚、文法正確？
options: Mia told Lily that her bag was in the classroom.
Mia told to Lily that her bag was in the classroom.
Mia told Lily that bag her was in the classroom.
answer: Mia told Lily that her bag was in the classroom.

wrong.Mia told to Lily that her bag was in the: tell 後面直接接人，不加 to；tell someone that...。
wrong.Mia told Lily that bag her was in the cl: 所有格 her 必須放在 bag 前面，語序顛倒。

why: tell + 人 + that 子句是正確結構；her 放名詞前面。
tip: tell 後面直接接對象，不加 to。
say: Mia told Lily that her bag was in the classroom.

prompt:
某段落先說「很多人認為網購比較方便」，接著說「但實體店家有其優勢」。空格處放哪個連接詞最適合？

Online shopping is convenient. _____ physical stores offer a chance to try products.

wrong.As a result,: As a result 表示結果，但後句是提出另一面，不是前句的結果。
wrong.Likewise,: Likewise 表示同樣的情形，但這裡是不同角度的比較。

why: 前句談網購優點，後句談實體店優點，兩個對照面，用 On the other hand。
tip: 另一面向的對照：On the other hand。
say: Online shopping is convenient. On the other hand, physical stores offer a chance to try products.

prompt: 哪一個選項最適合放在這個段落的結尾，總結重點？
text: Cycling reduces traffic. It saves money on fuel. It also keeps people healthy.
options: In short, cycling brings benefits to both people and the city.
Meanwhile, cars are becoming more expensive.
By contrast, buses are always crowded.
answer: In short, cycling brings benefits to both people and the city.

wrong.Meanwhile, cars are becoming more expens: Meanwhile 帶出另一件同時發生的事，並未總結前面三個優點。
By contrast 帶出對比，但段落主題是騎腳踏車的好處，不是公車。

why: 前三句列舉優點，結尾用 In short 總結成對人與城市都有益，主題一致。
tip: 總結句用 In short，主題要一致。
say: In short, cycling brings benefits to both people and the city.

prompt: 選出適合填入空格的字。
text: Some animals sleep during the day. _____, others are active only at night.

wrong.As a result: 後句不是前句造成的結果，而是相反的習性。
wrong.For instance: 後句不是舉例，而是對比另一類動物。

why: 白天睡 vs. 晚上活動，是對比，所以用 In contrast。
tip: Some... others... 常用對比連接語。
say: Some animals sleep during the day. In contrast, others are active only at night.

prompt: 在四空五選中，一個選項說：Soccer is the most popular sport in the world. 但整段在談一場校內科學展覽。這個選項最可能是什麼？
options: 干擾選項，因為主題與段落無關
正確答案，因為句子很有名
正確答案，因為使用了最高級
answer: 干擾選項，因為主題與段落無關

wrong.正確答案，因為句子很有名: 選答案要看與上下文的連貫性，不是句子是否有名。
wrong.正確答案，因為使用了最高級: 最高級句型本身不能決定對錯，主題才是重點。

why: 與段落的科學展覽毫無關係，無法銜接前後文，因此是干擾選項。
tip: 主題無關的選項，先排除。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Not only did she win, but she also set a new record.
Not only she won, but she also set a new record.
Not only did she won, but she also set a new record.
answer: Not only did she win, but she also set a new record.

wrong.Not only she won, but she also set a new: Not only 放句首時前半句要倒裝成 did she win。
wrong.Not only did she won, but she also set a: did 後面要接原形動詞 win，不能再用 won。

why: Not only 放句首要倒裝，用 did she + 原形動詞。
tip: Not only 開頭要倒裝：did she win。
say: Not only did she win, but she also set a new record.

prompt: In light of the new evidence, the school changed its plan. 其中 In light of 的意思最接近？
text: In light of the new evidence, the school changed its plan.

wrong.儘管有新的證據: 儘管要用 Despite 或 In spite of，In light of 表示「考慮到」。
wrong.在新的證據出現之前: 句中表示因證據而改變計畫，沒有時間先後的意思。

why: In light of = considering，表示根據、考慮到某事而做決定。
tip: in light of：考慮到、有鑑於。
say: In light of the new evidence, the school changed its plan.

prompt: 價格漲了，但銷量仍然成長。選出最適合的連接語。

wrong.Therefore: Therefore 表示因果，但價格上漲通常不會「因此」讓銷量成長，語意不合。
wrong.For example: 後句不是前句的例子，而是出乎預期的對比。

why: 價格上漲卻銷量成長是出乎預期的轉折，要用 Nevertheless（儘管如此）。
tip: 出乎預期的轉折用 Nevertheless。
say: Prices rose. Nevertheless, sales kept growing.
